chapterInfo.content:
19
Asase no kyekyɛ
1Na ntonto a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ba maa Simeon, Simeonfoɔ abusuakuo no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ; na wɔn agyapadeɛ da Yuda mma agyapadeɛ ntam. 2Na deɛ wɔnyaa no wɔn agyapadeɛ mu ne Beer-seba, Seba, Molada, 3Hasar-sual, Bala, Asem, 4Eltolad, Betul, Horma, 5Siklag, Bet-markabot, Hasar-susa, 6Bet-lebaot ne Saruhen: Nkuro dummiɛnsa ne ɛho nkuraa. 7Ain, Rimon, Eter ne Asan: Nkuro nnan ne ɛho nkuraa; 8ne nkuraa a ɛdeda nkuro yi ho hyia de kɔsi Baalat-beer nyinaa, Ramat a ɛda Negeb. Yei ne Simeon mma abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 9Yudafoɔ kyɛfa no bi na ɛyɛɛ Simeonfoɔ agyapadeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Yudafoɔ kyɛfa no boroo wɔn so, enti Simeonfoɔ nyaa agyapadeɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ no mu.
10Na tonto a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ba maa Sebulon sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn agyapadeɛ hyeɛ kɔduruu Sarid. 11Na wɔn hyeɛ no foro kɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Marala, na ɛkɔpem Dabeset, na ɛkɔpem subonhwa a ɛwɔ Yokneam apueeɛ fam no ano. 12Na ɛsane firi Sarid kɔ anim owiapueeɛ de kɔ Kislot-tabor hyeɛ so na ɛfiri adi kɔ Daberat, na ɛforo kɔ Yafia. 13Na ɛfiri hɔ twam kɔ apueeɛ de kɔ Gat-hefer, Et-kasin, na ɛfiri Rimon a ɛhima de kɔ Nea. 14Na ɛhyeɛ no konton kɔ atifi fam de kɔ Hanaton, na ano kɔduru Yifta-el bonhwa no mu; 15#Ate 1.30 ne Katat ne Nahalal ne Simron ne Yidala ne Betlehem: Nkuro dummienu ne ɛho nkuraa. 16Yei ne Sebulon mma agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
17Ntonto a ɛtɔ so nnan no ba maa Isakar, Isakarfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 18#2 Ah 4.8 Na wɔn hyeɛ kɔɔ Yesreel, Kesulot, Sunem, 19Hafraim, Sihon, Anaharat, 20Rabit, Kision, Abes, 21Remet, En-ganim, En-hada ne Bet-pases. 22Na ɛhyeɛ no kɔpem Tabor, Sahasima ne Bet-semes, na wɔn hyeɛ no ano kɔduru Yordan ano: Nkuro dunsia ne ɛho nkuraa. 23Yei ne Isakarfoɔ abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
24Na ntonto a ɛtɔ so nnum no ba maa Aserfoɔ abusuakuo no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 25Na wɔn hyeɛ ne Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf, 26Alamelek, Amad, ne Misal na ɛkɔpem Karmel wɔ atɔeɛ, ne Sihor-libnat. 27Na ɛsane kɔ owiapueeɛ de kɔ Bet-dagon, na ɛkɔpem Sebulon ne Yifta-el bonhwa mu, Bet-emek ne Neiel atifi fam, na ɛfiri adi kɔ Kabul atifi fam, 28Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, ne Kana de kɔsi Sidon Kɛseɛ. 29#Yos 15.44; Ate 1.31 Na ɛhyeɛ no dane kɔ Rama kɔduru kuro denden Tiro, na ɛhyeɛ no dane kɔ Hosa, na ano kɔpem ɛpo no Aksib fam, 30ne Uma ne Afek ne Rehob: Nkuro aduonu mmienu ne ɛho nkuraa. 31Ɛno ne Aserfoɔ abusuakuo agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
32Naftalifoɔ na ntonto a ɛtɔ so nsia no ba maa wɔn, Naftalifoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. 33Na wɔn hyeɛ firi Helef, Saananim dupɔn no ho ne Adami-nekeb ne Yabneel de kɔ Lakum, na ano kɔpem Yordan. 34Na ɛhyeɛ no dane kɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Asnot-tabor, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Hukok, na ɛkɔpem Sebulon anafoɔ fam, ne Aser wɔ atɔeɛ, ne Yuda wɔ apueeɛ, Yordan ano. 35Na nkuro a wɔatoto ho afasuo nie: Sidim, Ser, Hamat, Rakat, Kineret, 36Adama, Rama, Hasor, 37Kedes, Edrei, En-hasor, 38#Ate 1.33 Yiron, Midgal-el, Horem, Bet-anat ne Bet-semes: Nkuro dunkron ne ɛho nkuraa. 39Yei ne Naftalifoɔ abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
40Dan mma abusuakuo no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ na ntonto a ɛtɔ so nson no ba maa wɔn. 41Na wɔn agyapadeɛ hyeɛ ne: Sora, Estaol, Ir-semes, 42#Ate 1.35 Saalabin, Ayalon, Yitla, 43Elon, Timna, Ekron, 44Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat, 45Yehud, Bene-berak, Gat-rimon, 46#Yona 1.3 Me-yarkon, Rakon, ɛne Yafo anim hyeɛ no. 47#Ate 18.27, 29 Na Danfoɔ firii hɔ kɔnyaa ɛhyeɛ foforɔ bi, ɛfiri sɛ Danfoɔ no foro kɔe ne Lesem kɔkoe, na wɔfae, na wɔde nkrantɛ ano sɛee no, na wɔdii so, na wɔtenaa hɔ, na wɔfrɛɛ Lesem sɛ Dan, sɛdeɛ wɔn agya Dan din teɛ. 48Ɛno ne Danfoɔ abusuakuo agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
49Na wɔwiee asase no mu kyɛ sɛdeɛ n’ahyeɛ no teɛ no, Israelfoɔ maa Nun ba Yosua agyapadeɛ wɔ wɔn mu, 50#Yos 24.30 AWURADE anomu asɛm so na wɔmaa no kuro a ɔbisaeɛ no, ɛne Timnat-sera a ɛda Efraim bepɔ soɔ, na ɔkyekyeree kuro no tenaa mu.
51 # Yos 14.1; 18.1 Yeinom ne agyapadeɛ a Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne Nun ba Yosua ne Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo agyanom mu atitire no de ntonto kyɛɛ mu wɔ Silo, AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. Na wɔwiee asase no mu kyɛ.

Na ntonto a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ba maa Simeon, Simeonfoɔ abusuakuo no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ; na wɔn agyapadeɛ da Yuda mma agyapadeɛ ntam. Yudafoɔ kyɛfa no bi na ɛyɛɛ Simeonfoɔ agyapadeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Yudafoɔ kyɛfa no boroo wɔn so, enti Simeonfoɔ nyaa agyapadeɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ no mu.
Na tonto a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ba maa Sebulon sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn agyapadeɛ hyeɛ kɔduruu Sarid. Na wɔn hyeɛ no foro kɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Marala, na ɛkɔpem Dabeset, na ɛkɔpem subonhwa a ɛwɔ Yokneam apueeɛ fam no ano. Yei ne Sebulon mma agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ntonto a ɛtɔ so nnan no ba maa Isakar, Isakarfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn hyeɛ kɔɔ Yesreel, Kesulot, Sunem, Hafraim, Sihon, Anaharat, Rabit, Kision, Abes, Remet, En-ganim, En-hada ne Bet-pases. Yei ne Isakarfoɔ abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Na ntonto a ɛtɔ so nnum no ba maa Aserfoɔ abusuakuo no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn hyeɛ ne Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf, Alamelek, Amad, ne Misal na ɛkɔpem Karmel wɔ atɔeɛ, ne Sihor-libnat. Na ɛsane kɔ owiapueeɛ de kɔ Bet-dagon, na ɛkɔpem Sebulon ne Yifta-el bonhwa mu, Bet-emek ne Neiel atifi fam, na ɛfiri adi kɔ Kabul atifi fam, Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, ne Kana de kɔsi Sidon Kɛseɛ. Na ɛhyeɛ no dane kɔ Rama kɔduru kuro denden Tiro, na ɛhyeɛ no dane kɔ Hosa, na ano kɔpem ɛpo no Aksib fam, ne Uma ne Afek ne Rehob: Nkuro aduonu mmienu ne ɛho nkuraa. Ɛno ne Aserfoɔ abusuakuo agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Naftalifoɔ na ntonto a ɛtɔ so nsia no ba maa wɔn, Naftalifoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ. Na wɔn hyeɛ firi Helef, Saananim dupɔn no ho ne Adami-nekeb ne Yabneel de kɔ Lakum, na ano kɔpem Yordan. Na nkuro a wɔatoto ho afasuo nie: Sidim, Ser, Hamat, Rakat, Kineret, Adama, Rama, Hasor, Kedes, Edrei, En-hasor, Yiron, Midgal-el, Horem, Bet-anat ne Bet-semes: Nkuro dunkron ne ɛho nkuraa. Yei ne Naftalifoɔ abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.
Dan mma abusuakuo no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ na ntonto a ɛtɔ so nson no ba maa wɔn. Ɛno ne Danfoɔ abusuakuo agyapadeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ: Nkuro no ne ɛho nkuraa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
